description: This library provides ten benchmark sets for capacitated arc routing with time limits and intermediate unloading facilities. University of Pretoria researchers supply five mixed-network sets and five undirected-network sets, representing waste-collection routing. Centurion and Actonville examples use real road layouts, while other sets extend earlier artificial benchmarks. Version 2 documents TXT instances packaged as ZIP files and a PDF format guide. Coverage is benchmark networks, not a dated operating dataset; Centurion service costs and waste quantities were inferred because accurate observations were unavailable. Selected sets use seconds and kilograms, while units for other sets remain unknown. Mendeley states CC BY 4.0 and free access. These assumptions and unit gaps are limitations for operational simulation. data-saltillo-waste-collection-2ecvrp-if-instances is related; model-sumo could support separate traffic analysis. The named repository page was readable through the web reader, but the public API returned 502 and current archive contents were not verified or downloaded.
